# @k8ordo/framework-engine

> Internal. An application installs `@k8ordo/static` or `@k8ordo/server`, never
> this package; it is published only so those two can resolve it. It holds
> what both modes share: the `routes/` grammar, the generator for the route
> table and the type wiring, the RSC pipeline and its configuration, the
> execution-boundary enforcement, and the request handler the modes call at
> different times.

When installed via npm, these docs live under `node_modules/@k8ordo/framework-engine/docs/`.

## Guide

- [Design Guide](GUIDE.md): what lives here and where the application-facing
  documentation is instead.
